title: The Inverted Image at the Water; The Five Births of Food
description: T89 reads the inverted face at the water as the mystery of the Call and the Answer. When a person gazes at still water, his face appears below with head turned downward — a sign that the natural mind is full of inward correspondences. The image high cast inverted in what receives it gives the form of the Lord's Call descending to meet what has fallen. When the man rises and his face still appears cast downward as he stands, this is the corresponding Answer, the soul's hearing rising back to the Father. The conversation is one structure with two motions. T90 names the five offspring of food: breath of thought, voice/speech, power exerted with shame at one's nakedness, the joining of love and wisdom, and the molded outer work in flesh. The soul recognizes only the last and grieves over only the last, while the four hidden productions are equally born from the nourishment received.
